title: Peak Program for 3 Lifts
author: Julie
desc: Designed to focus on the three main lifts for strength development: squat, bench press, and deadlift.

ex.note:
Choose back or front squat  
3 sets x 7-9 reps 
If you hit 9 reps, increase next week
If you hit 7-9 reps, keep weight the same

Choose bench or incline bench press 
3 sets x 6-9 reps 
If you hit 9, increase next week 
If landing between 6-9, keep weight the same

Sit up straight 
3 sets x 7-9 reps

- front plank 
- reverse crunch 
- incline reverse 
- hanging leg raise 
3 sets x 6-9 reps
3 sets x 12 reps

- incline bench press
- Larsen bench press 
- close grip bench press 
1 set x 6 reps w/1-2 in reserve
3 sets x 7 reps @88-90% of top set

- sumo or conventional deadlift
- 1 set x 3 reps w/ 2-3 in reserve 
- 4 sets x 3 reps @88-90% of top set

- hands elevated push up 
- BW push up 
- weighted push up 
- dumbbell bench press 
- dumbbell incline bench press

- chip up 
- pull up 
- try to do clusters

- do it with a short bar on the tricep rope push down 
- skull crushers

- dumbbell lat raise 
- lean in db lat raise 
- cross body lat raise

- front squat 
- tempo back squat (down slowly & shoot st8 back up 
- pause squat (pause 1 Mississippi & st8 up) 
- Ssb squat 
1 set x 3 reps w/2-3 reps in reserve 
3 sets x 4 reps @88-90% of top set

-DB reverse lunge 
- front foot elevated reverse lunge 
- walking lunge 
- 7 reps each side
- DB bent over row (3 pt row)

RDL 
- kickstand RDL 
- single leg RDL
- landmine single RDL 
- slow and steady on the way down
Side plank w hip drop

- bench press 
- incline bench press 
- 1 sets x 3 reps w/2-3 reps in reserve
3 sets x 4 reps w/2-3 in reserve

- high incline db bench press
- high incline db bench press w/slow eccentric (slow otw down)
- front plank

- db curl 
- spider curl 
- barbell curl 
- zottman curl

YMCA y raise 
- y raise and weights facing upwards like a \/
